description.narrative: The goal of PEPFAR funding is to initiate a data revolution to achieve greater transparency, mutual accountability and local impact in Sub-Saharan Africa. The program will seek to attempt to address some of the root causes of insufficient data use for decision-making around HIV/AIDS, broader health, gender equality, and economic growth.
